messages.subject: Whitmore — execution version ready
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel, Lorna,

The Board resolved to approve the settlement yesterday. The execution version of the Settlement Agreement is finalised (Whitmore_SettlementAgreement_Executed) at £185,000 with the 14-day payment window and the agreed reference. We'll arrange signature by Iqbal and the Company Secretary and by Dr Whitmore, with Deepa Kovac's adviser's certificate. Payment falls due within 14 days of the later of full signature and receipt of the certificate.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
